newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daikyo to appoint president from Sanwa unit - report.
newsitem.headline: Daikyo to appoint president from Sanwa unit - report.

text.p: Masaharu Hasegawa, president of Sanwa Bank Ltd's finance unit, will become president of Japanese condominium builder Daikyo Inc, a wire service affiliated with the daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Friday.
Hasegawa, president of Sanwa Business Credit Co Ltd, will replace Shuji Yokoyama at the helm of the troubled Daikyo, which has accumulated massive debts in the wake of plunging land prices.
The company hopes Sanwa Bank will aid in its restructuring, the wire service quoted company sources as saying.
Daikyo will reduce its annual dividend to 7.5 yen per share for the business year ended last month, from 10 yen the previous year, it said.
Spokesmen for both Daikyo and Sanwa Business Credit declined to comment.
